about: Card 10A-1c: 241 inclusion lines written before any rule of card 10A-1c changed (en 81, ja 80, zh-TW 80), kept apart from the other tables and scored apart. 121 must be held: the coded concept is negated, excepted or doubtful. 120 must run: the coded concept is present and a cue is about something else. Each row has a 'hold_class' saying what shape it tests: 'second' (a negated second thing that is not a candidate), 'modifier' (a same-clause modifier: 'X without Y', 'YのないX', '未使用Y之X'), 'coded_name' (the coded name is not written as coded), 'and_positive' (a positive item after the cue's clause: ', and confirmed Y', 'なく、Y', '且Y'), 'no_contraindication', 'excepted' (the item an exception names), 'cue_in_name', 'plain' (no cue), 'negated' (a must-hold row). Many must-hold rows are the same text as a must-run row with the negated thing coded instead: the near miss. 'others' are the line's other concept candidates as the extractor would emit them. 'over_held' marks a must-run row the rule still holds (counted, not hidden). Synthetic; no patient data.
